subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Though the house belonged to my father, the ______ banyan tree was mine.
solution:
The correct answer is** "magnificent"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Magnificent** means **big and spectacular**.

 
 
• ​**Example:** *The stars looked **magnificent** through the telescope. *
 
 
 
• **Banyan Trees** are mostly **big**.
 
• Therefore, the adjective that best describes the banyan tree is "magnificent". 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Waterlogged** - filled with water.

 
 
• **Example:** *The bridge was **waterlogged** after the heavy rains. *
 
 
 
• **Inclusive** - included with.
 
 
• **Example: ***This tour package is **inclusive** of both stay and food. *
 
 
 
• **Exalted** - elevate a person in rank or position. 
 
 
• **Example:** *The team leader got **exalted** to the position of Manager.*
